description: This file contains functions for preparing and managing UBI devices in an OpenWrt environment, specifically tailored for Buffalo hardware. It defines procedures to attach UBI volumes, remove volumes, create new volumes, and update hash information necessary for firmware updates.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares UBI devices for OpenWrt installation by removing specific volumes related to root filesystem and firmware hash.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_optvol
methods.description: Recreates UBI volumes for root filesystem and firmware hash, updating the hash volume with dummy data for verification purposes.
